prompts: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: game sprite atlas. Create ONE transparent RGBA atlas exactly 1536x1024 pixels, THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows, six 512x512 cells. Five supplied reference images correspond exactly to cells 1–5 in row-major order; cell 6 (bottom right) is completely empty transparent. Identity order: 1. Turabi Çamkıran; 2. Ogeday Girişken; 3. Nihat Altınkaya; 4. Nagihan Karadere; 5. Merve Aydın. Preserve each distinct reference person's actual face, hairstyle, facial hair, gender, body build and hair color; no generic substitutions or duplicate faces. Extend each into a photorealistic complete athletic FULL BODY standing naturally, almost front facing with mild right three-quarter orientation, both arms naturally hanging with small gaps from the torso so limbs can be animated. Both hands and feet fully visible. Natural realistic adult proportions. Each figure between y+30 and y+485 in its own cell, feet aligned. Sportswear matching each reference top's color, modest athletic shorts or leggings, trail-running shoes. Nihat if present: sports shirt instead of suit, retain face. No crossed arms, objects, props, chairs, floor, scenery, borders, lettering, obvious logos. Genuine clean transparent background between figures. Center each person in their own exact cell with >=30px transparent margins, no overlap. Consistent soft studio lighting and realistic skin/fabric. Identity-preserving body extension, not portraits.
